summary: Silicom Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a design win with a Tier-1 cyber security leader for a new white-label switch family. The deal involves no equity consideration, price per share, or special-situation event; it is a standard product sale expected to generate $5 million annually after ramp-up. Samples are delivered, with first production orders in 2026. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural mechanics beyond ordinary-course supply. This is a routine current report, not a special situation.
